hooks.name: Append to Changelog
hooks.description: After any file is created or edited, appends a timestamped summary to changelog.txt

action.prompt: A file was just created or modified. Append a new entry to the file `changelog.txt` in the workspace root (create it if it doesn't exist). The entry should be on its own line with the format: `[YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM] - <short summary of what was changed and why>`. Do NOT overwrite existing entries — always append. Keep summaries to one concise sentence.
